gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an opening gross claims reserve of GBP 321.0m at 1 January 2016. During 2016 there was net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 15.7m (a c.4.9% release of opening gross claims reserves) primarily driven by a reduction in medical malpractice (professional/casualty) case assessments and the release of catastrophe loadings on the 2015 year as policies came off risk. The movement is supported by the syndicate's claims development table which shows net reductions across older years (overall release).

The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 26.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end.
gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Claims development table) because no single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' insurance-liabilities line was provided. The triangle includes RITC adjustments from Syndicate 6103 (noted in the report) which the syndicate states have been incorporated into the triangles 'as if they had always been the liabilities of 2791'; the calculation excludes the two most recent underwriting years per the methodology. Figures are rounded to three decimal millions. Confidence is moderate-high (0.8) for the PYD derived from the triangle; other LOB-specific movements are not separately quantified in the statements and are therefore reported with lower confidence.
